steps.caption: Passport appears as a new unpacked item and the add field is ready for the next entry.
The markup-like name Hat is displayed as literal text beneath Passport, and both items remain unpacked.
Before renaming, Rain coat is visibly packed while Socks is still to pack.
The Rain coat row opens a focused rename form with explicit Save and Cancel actions.
Jacket replaces Rain coat in the same row and remains packed; Socks is unchanged.
The All view starts with Passport and Socks both marked To pack.
Passport is visibly Packed with a checked control and crossed-out name; Socks remains To pack.
The selected To pack view shows Socks and hides packed Passport without deleting it.
Back in All, Passport can be marked not packed again and both items are To pack.
Passport, Socks, and Jacket are visible in insertion order before deletion.
Socks is gone after deletion while Passport and Jacket remain in their original order.
A whitespace-only add is rejected with an inline message and no item row is created.
A blank rename stays open with its own validation message while Passport remains the saved packed item.
Escape cancels the invalid rename and restores packed Passport unchanged.
Immediately before reload, To pack is selected and shows only Socks; packed Jacket is filtered out and deleted Hat is absent.
After a real reload, All is restored and the saved list still has packed Jacket and unpacked Socks while Hat stays deleted.

steps.caption: Passport appears as a new unpacked item and the add field is ready for the next entry.
The markup-like name Hat is displayed as literal text beneath Passport, and both items remain unpacked.
Before renaming, Rain coat is visibly packed while Socks is still to pack.
The Rain coat row opens a focused rename form with explicit Save and Cancel actions.
Jacket replaces Rain coat in the same row and remains packed; Socks is unchanged.
The All view starts with Passport and Socks both marked To pack.
Passport is visibly Packed with a checked control and crossed-out name; Socks remains To pack.
The selected To pack view shows Socks and hides packed Passport without deleting it.
Back in All, Passport can be marked not packed again and both items are To pack.
Passport, Socks, and Jacket are visible in insertion order before deletion.
Socks is gone after deletion while Passport and Jacket remain in their original order.
A whitespace-only add is rejected with an inline message and no item row is created.
A blank rename stays open with its own validation message while Passport remains the saved packed item.
Escape cancels the invalid rename and restores packed Passport unchanged.
Immediately before reload, To pack is selected and shows only Socks; packed Jacket is filtered out and deleted Hat is absent.
After a real reload, All is restored and the saved list still has packed Jacket and unpacked Socks while Hat stays deleted.
